limitations: Full text of Nassa et al. 2014 (PMID 24525454) was not retrievable (Europe PMC 500, PMC/publisher blocked); no sample-prep or iTRAQ channel map was available.
iTRAQ channel -> condition (ERbeta+ vs ERbeta-, etc.) is undecodable; sources are named by compartment+channel and no factor value or treatment column is given.

Whether the two fractionation series per compartment are technical or biological replicates is unknown; coded as technical replicate 1/2 (grouping by acquisition date) with biological replicate 1; also unknown whether channel identities are consistent across the two series.
Fraction numbers were set by a scripted patch of the built file (gaps in deposited fractions; cyto series1 lacks B8,B13 and nucl series1 lacks B11 (not deposited), cyto series2 lacks B11-B13).
Cellular compartment derives from run-name words cyto/nucl, labelled as cytoplasmic/nuclear fraction.

Sex (female) is the Cellosaurus value; age left not available. Variable modifications not extractable (ProteinPilot Biological modifications focus uses probability-weighted mod lists); only fixed mods reported. Dissociation not stated, not available. Tolerances are ProteinPilot values recorded in the XML.
.wiff.scan companion files (52) are not rows; each .wiff claimed once x 4 channels = 208 rows. Fractionation method not stated (not annotated).

Revised after independent review: the two acquisition series per compartment are NOT asserted to be technical replicates. Each series has its own source names (cyto-s1/cyto-s2/nucl-s1/nucl-s2), all with technical replicate 1 and biological replicate 1 as placeholders; the real replicate design and the channel-to-condition (ERbeta +/-) mapping are unknown.
